places.name: Devils Tower National Monument
places.ai_summary: A striking geological feature and the first national monument in the USA, sacred to Native Americans.

opening_hours.notes: Visitor center open 9 AM - 4 PM, closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas.

places.place_tip: Attend a ranger program to learn about the tower's geology and history.

places.name: Grand Prismatic Spring
places.ai_summary: The largest hot spring in the USA, known for its vibrant colors and stunning microbial mats.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed in the morning for steam and color contrast.

places.place_tip: Walk the boardwalk for different perspectives of the spring.

places.name: Old Faithful Geyser
places.ai_summary: Famous for its predictable eruptions, this geyser is a must-see in Yellowstone National Park.

opening_hours.notes: Check the predicted eruption times at the visitor center.

places.place_tip: Stay at least 100 yards away from the geyser and follow park regulations.
